command:
set -eu
work=/srv/legacy2/mail-filter-routing
new="$work/bin/.deliver.new.$$"
trap 'rm -f "$new"' 0 HUP INT TERM
umask 077
cat > "$new" <<'DELIVER_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

umask 077
base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
maildir=$base/Maildir

for box in accounts support general; do
    mkdir -p "$maildir/$box/cur" "$maildir/$box/new" "$maildir/$box/tmp"
done

stage=$(mktemp "$maildir/general/tmp/.deliver.XXXXXXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f "$stage"' 0 HUP INT TERM
cat > "$stage"

box=$(awk '
function save_header(    value) {
    if (!in_department)
        return
    value = department
    gsub(/^[[:space:]]+/, "", value)
    gsub(/[[:space:]]+$/, "", value)
    if (value == "accounts")
        found_accounts = 1
    else if (value == "support")
        found_support = 1
    in_department = 0
    department = ""
}
{
    line = $0
    sub(/\r$/, "", line)
    if (line == "") {
        save_header()
        finished = 1
        exit
    }
    if (line ~ /^[ \t]/) {
        if (in_department) {
            sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", line)
            department = department " " line
        }
        next
    }
    save_header()
    colon = index(line, ":")
    if (colon > 1) {
        name = substr(line, 1, colon - 1)
        if (tolower(name) == "x-department") {
            in_department = 1
            department = substr(line, colon + 1)
        }
    }
}
END {
    if (!finished)
        save_header()
    if (found_accounts)
        print "accounts"
    else if (found_support)
        print "support"
    else
        print "general"
}
' "$stage")

host=$(hostname | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9._-' '_')
stamp=$(date +%s%N)
name="$stamp.P$$.$host"
sequence=0
while [ -e "$maildir/$box/new/$name" ]; do
    sequence=$((sequence + 1))
    name="$stamp.P$$.Q$sequence.$host"
done
mv "$stage" "$maildir/$box/new/$name"
trap - 0 HUP INT TERM
DELIVER_EOF
sh -n "$new"
chmod 0755 "$new"
chown --reference="$work/bin/deliver" "$new"
mv -f "$new" "$work/bin/deliver"
trap - 0 HUP INT TERM
restorecon "$work/bin/deliver" 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '[installed]'
ls -lZ "$work/bin/deliver"
sh -n "$work/bin/deliver"
printf '%s\n' 'syntax=ok'
